headline: Foreigners Buy 1 Trillion Won Worth; KOSPI Recovers the 6,600 Level
summary: KOSPI traded at the 6,600 level with an intraday gain above 4%, and a buy sidecar was triggered as KOSDAQ strength spread. Foreigners bought about 1 trillion won worth of shares.
why: The KOSPI is South Korea's main benchmark stock index, tracking large listed companies on the Korea Exchange. Foreign flows are closely watched as a gauge of international investor sentiment toward Korean equities.
